name_story.story: Sabahudin can be understood through the Arabic form صَبَاحُ الدِّين, whose central sense is sabahudin; morning of the faith. Sabahudin is the Bosnian form of Arabic صَبَاحُ الدِّين (Ṣabāḥ al-Dīn), meaning 'morning of the faith'.

faq.a: Sabahudin is associated with the Arabic form صَبَاحُ الدِّين, whose core sense is sabahudin; morning of the faith.

faq.q: What is the origin of Sabahudin?
faq.a: Sabahudin is associated with Arabic. Sabahudin is the Bosnian form of Arabic صَبَاحُ الدِّين (Ṣabāḥ al-Dīn), meaning 'morning of the faith'.
Yes — the underlying form صَبَاحُ الدِّين is Arabic.
Sabahudin can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Sabahudin should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṣabāḥ al-Dīn is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Sabahudin mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Sabahudin is rendered صباح الدین and carries the sense صباح الدین، دین کی صبح.

faq.q: What does Sabahudin mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Sabahudin is rendered صباح‌الدین and carries the sense صباح‌الدین، صبح دین.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-ba-hu-din. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Sabahudin?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Sabahudin, sabahudin. Script forms are صباح الدين, صباح الدین, صباح‌الدین, صَبَاحُ الدِّين, सबाहुद्दीन.

faq.q: Is Sabahudin a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
